items.why: Chip stocks are leading the wipeout, with the Nasdaq plunging 5% amid the chip stock selloff and tech stocks down on AI worries.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
AI stocks are in free-fall as investors panic over a possible data center slowdown, and tech stocks are down today including Nvidia.
The fear gauge is spiking as stocks plunge and the S&P 500 tumbles more than 3.5%.

market_note: Nasdaq futures down 6.47% and S&P futures down 4.53%, while gold is up 0.58% and oil is up 2.78%.
summary: Stocks are plunging, with the Nasdaq down about 5% as chip stocks wipe out and the S&P 500 tumbling more than 3.5%. AI worries are crushing tech shares and sending Wall Street reeling.
